rows.metric: binary institutional operational status (preactivation arrangement vs activated continuous sharing)
rows.baseline: 2014 Trilateral Information Sharing Arrangement and pre-existing bilateral channels; Japan-ROK GSOMIA restored before 2023 Camp David summit
rows.followup: Activated December 19, 2023; continued operation publicly confirmed by July 2024 US-Japan Security Consultative Committee
rows.reason: Binary activation is not an operational performance magnitude.

rows.baseline: Embassies closed and diplomatic relations severed since 2016
rows.reason: Reopened missions do not quantify China's marginal role or costs.

rows.metric: binary legal status of the same bilateral treaty (not-in-force vs in-force)
rows.baseline: Russia–Belarus bilateral security guarantees treaty signed December 6, 2024 but not yet legally in force
rows.followup: Russia–Belarus bilateral security guarantees treaty entered into force March 13, 2025
rows.reason: Treaty entry into force is not a measured operational change.

rows.metric: EUR nominal financial reference amount for successive approximately two-year mandates of the same EUPM mission
rows.baseline: EUPM Moldova first mandate 24 April 2023–21 May 2025: financial reference amount EUR 13,356,508.08
rows.followup: EUPM Moldova renewed mandate 22 May 2025–31 May 2027: financial reference amount EUR 19,817,594.70
rows.reason: Reference amounts are neither actual spending nor delivered outcomes; mandate lengths differ.

rows.metric: nominal bilateral merchandise trade USD billion
rows.reason: Nominal trade values confound price, volume and exogenous market conditions.

decision: Do not average binary status, nominal financial reference amounts and nominal trade flows into a composite without a preregistered and validated common outcome model.
